content: Center camping seems to be the key with the current rules. Also most of the action seems to start when the circle shrinks. I'm wondering if a hole in the center could be interesting. Or maybe a "push" magnet in the center. Or instead of a shrinking circle make it a moving circle so the blobs have to keep moving inside, creating movement and fighting. Or mabye shrink from turn 1 but pause the shrinking for 10 turns every 10 turns or something like that. Maybe there could be resources spawnning here and there giving a stamina boost over time or something worth picking up. Maybe we could increase colision force or decrease friction as well. A pack of 6 blobs together is pretty resistant.
